dedupe_keys.name: data on landscape metrics at different scales kef siliana region and sub spatial units of agroecological living lab landscape in tunisia 2017 2022

description: MELDATA, hosted by the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas, publishes landscape-metric tables for Kef-Siliana in north-west Tunisia. The metrics summarize 2017 and 2022 land-cover patterns at the regional scale and within agroecological living-lab subunits. The provider says it processed land-cover data with the LecoS QGIS plugin for this separate purpose. The named page and public API list two metric CSV tables and three dictionary files. The licence is CC BY-SA 4.0 and the page shows no price. For simulation, land-use or agricultural adaptation modellers could use these metrics as aggregate checks on landscape fragmentation assumptions or compare scenario outputs at the same spatial units. They are derived metrics, not the source raster or a direct map of infrastructure assets. No file was downloaded, so exact metric columns and numerical quality remain unchecked. This release is related to the catalogue AGRIDATA Tunisia portal as regional context and to the separate MELDATA change-map and dynamics releases described by the same MDPI article. A caveat is that changes in these aggregate indicators cannot by themselves identify which field or infrastructure asset changed.
